_doc: Reading on without a pause (audit AUD-004): the idle save timer restarts on every turn, so the reader also saves when its unsaved position is 60 s old (SR-PL-08).

storage.write_ms.count.why: SR-PL-08: while reading on, the position is saved at least every 60 s; the script ends before the idle save could run

display.underruns.why: the save waits for an idle panel between turns
